The user's raw input prompt is in English. Therefore the output must be in English.

Let me carefully analyze the input image and the instructions.

Input image: A young woman standing on a tree-lined commercial street, long brown hair with a side braid draped over the left shoulder (her left, viewer's right), wavy bangs framing the face. Wearing a pastel gradient smocked tank top with pink ruffled trim at the neckline (colors shift from pink/lavender to cream/yellow), a light green knit cardigan, and a tiered pastel skirt with pink and cream/yellow horizontal tiers. Accessories: layered silver necklaces (one choker-style, one longer pendant necklace). Holding a green drink cup with a straw in her left hand (viewer's right). Background: outdoor street with buildings, trees, pedestrians, sunlight.

User's instruction: Replace the background entirely with a pure white seamless studio background, and create a premium studio portrait and body reference sheet with an asymmetric two-part layout:
- Left panel (~1/3 width): close-up upper-body portrait from top of head to mid-torso/waist, facing camera directly, eyes looking into lens, shoulders parallel, neutral posture. Preserve facial expression, hairstyle, facial features, upper garment details.
- Right panel (~2/3 width): three-view body reference set (front, side, back), all completely headless — cropped at the base of the neck, showing only from neck down to feet. No head, face, hair, ears.
- Dividers: one thin straight vertical line between left portrait and right panel; two additional thin vertical lines within the right panel separating front/side/back.
- Lighting: unified professional studio lighting, soft directional key light, natural shadow shaping.
- Quality: realistic skin texture, accurate hair texture, garment material rendering; consistent studio lighting across the three views; realistic drape, folds, seams.
- Identity preservation: match the reference image's face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, colors, materials.
- Negative constraints: no head in the right panel; no text, watermarks, logos, labels, annotations, borders.

This is a Type B/C generation task — generating a new graphic (reference sheet) based on the subject reference image. Actually it's closer to Type C: generating from a subject reference image. But it's not an information-rich infographic; it's a reference sheet layout. The mandatory minimum length of 4000 characters

Regardless of the background appearing in the reference image (white, outdoor, or any environment), replace it entirely and render the final output as a premium studio portrait and body-reference sheet with a perfectly uniform, pure white seamless background. The white background must be identical across all panels, with absolutely no environmental elements, shadows, or gradients.

## Overall Layout

Generate a single image with an asymmetric two-part layout:

- **Left panel (~1/3 of the total image width):** A close-up upper-body portrait of the subject, framed from the top of the head to the mid-torso or waist. The entire head and face must be clearly visible. The subject faces directly toward the camera, with eyes looking straight into the lens, shoulders parallel to the image plane, and a neutral, natural posture. Preserve the subject's facial expression, hairstyle, facial features, and upper garment details.

- **Right panel (~2/3 of the total image width):** A three-view body-reference set of the exact same subject, consisting of front, side, and back views. **All three views must be completely headless, with the entire head removed from the composition. Show only the body from the base of the neck downward to the feet.** The head, face, hair, ears, and all facial features must not appear in any of the three body views.

## Right Panel: Headless Three-View Body Reference

Arrange three full-height body views side by side, evenly spaced and precisely aligned in scale, body height, and vertical baseline.

1. **Front view:** A straight-on frontal view of the body, cropped precisely at the base of the neck. The neck must terminate naturally at the neckline, with no head above it. Show the complete torso, arms, hands, legs, and feet. Maintain a neutral standing posture with arms naturally positioned.

2. **Side view:** A strict 90-degree side-profile view of the body, cropped at the same anatomical level at the base of the neck. No head, face, hair, or ears. Show the natural side silhouette of the neck base, shoulders, chest, waist, hips, arms, legs, and feet.

3. **Back view:** A straight rear view of the body, cropped at the base of the neck. No head or hair. Clearly show the back of the neck base, shoulders, upper back, garment construction, waist, hips, legs, and feet.

**Critical cropping requirement:** The headless appearance must be intentional, clean, and consistent across all three views. The upper boundary of each body view must align at the same anatomical level around the base of the neck. Do not replace the missing head with a mannequin head, blank head, featureless head, silhouette, or any other head-shaped object. Do not crop away the shoulders or upper torso. Preserve the natural neck base and garment neckline where applicable.

The three views must use identical body scale, consistent proportions, and matching foot alignment. The entire body from the neck base to the feet must remain visible without cropping the hands, arms, legs, or shoes.

## Panel Dividers and Layout

Separate the left portrait panel from the right three-view panel with one thin, straight vertical divider line.

Within the right panel, use two additional thin, straight vertical divider lines to separate the front, side, and back body views. All divider lines must be clean, subtle, evenly aligned, and minimalist.

The left portrait must remain visually distinct from the headless body-reference views on the right.

## Lighting, Texture, and Rendering Quality

Apply unified, controlled professional studio lighting throughout the entire composition, with soft but directional key light, natural shadow shaping, and realistic light-dark contrast.

For the left portrait:
- Crisp, realistic eye details and natural facial features.
- Authentic skin texture with visible natural pores and subtle skin details.
- No excessive skin smoothing, airbrushing, or artificial beauty filters.
- Accurate hairstyle, hair texture, and garment material rendering.

For the three headless body views:
- Consistent studio lighting and light direction across all three angles.
- Realistic garment draping, fabric folds, stitching, seams, and material texture.
- Accurate body anatomy, natural limb proportions, and realistic body contours.
- Clear visibility of the clothing's front, side, and back construction.
- Consistent exposure, color, and texture across all three views.

## Reference Fidelity and Identity Preservation

The subject's identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, clothing colors, fabric materials, and overall styling must faithfully match the provided reference image.

The left panel preserves the subject's complete head and face. The three right-side views preserve the same person's body shape and clothing but intentionally exclude the entire head.

Do not invent a different outfit, alter the person's body proportions, change garment details, or introduce accessories that are absent from the reference image. Maintain visual consistency between the portrait and all three body views.

The background in every panel must be pure white (#FFFFFF), seamless, uniform, and free of environmental details.

## Strict Negative Constraints

Absolutely no head in any of the three right-side body views. No face, hair, ears, eyes, nose, mouth, skull, head silhouette, mannequin head, or head-shaped placeholder in the right panel.

No text, watermarks, logos, subtitles, UI elements, panel labels, angle annotations, measurement guides, decorative graphics, borders around the overall image, or any additional content.

The final image must look like a premium professional studio reference sheet: one detailed, full-head portrait on the left and three precisely aligned, headless body views on the right, all on a consistent pure white background.
